title: Campaign-safe synthetic actor provisioning
goal: Provision only campaign-owned synthetic actors and records in verified isolated staging, without adopting or resetting existing users

in: Implement a fail-closed campaign-owned synthetic actor provisioner and non-secret actor manifest.
Verify isolated staging target, campaign namespace, existing-user refusal, and no credential publication.
out: Running against production or deleting campaign records.

acceptance_criteria: Unique campaign ID prefixes every provisioned identity and record.
Existing untagged or ambiguous users cause a hard refusal without password or metadata updates.
Target isolation and payment test mode are validated before hosted mutation.
Manifest contains non-secret IDs and actor intent only; focused tests prove refusal paths.

evidence: Local: npx vitest run __tests__/qa/campaign-actor-provisioner.test.ts passed (6 tests); scoped ESLint passed.
Local: health release metadata tests passed (9 tests) and npm run check:public-surface passed.
No hosted Auth request or mutation was made.

2026-09-22 local release/QA gate wave: 13 deployment/topology/evidence/workflow Node tests, 7 actor-provisioner tests, 7 mobile gate tests, launch fixture contract, public-surface check, focused ESLint, and workflow YAML parse passed. Hosted deployment, certification, and simulation were not run.
